composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate required fields first, so a missing/blank field is a 400 listing every
# offending field before the body is mapped to an entity.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Reject with 400 when a supplied postcode is malformed (not 4 digits) or out of range for the
# city's region. Absent postcode is accepted (optional). Runs after the required-field validation,
# so the city is known before its region range is applied.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

# Reject with 409 when the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.
checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyCreateLimit

# Reject with 429 when 100 or more owners have already been created today (by registrationDate).
checkDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Assign the deterministic 'householdId' (first 12 hex of SHA-256 over lastName + '|' + postcode),
# so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkHousehold

# Household-duplicate block: reject with 409 when the new owner's computed householdId already
# belongs to an existing owner, UNLESS the body declared 'sharesHousehold' (a declared household
# member bypasses this block). Runs after the householdId is assigned and before the identity check.
checkHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckHouseholdUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentity

# Consolidated duplicate check: reject with 409 when the new owner's whole identityKey
# (normalizedTelephone|email|householdId) equals an existing owner's. Runs after the householdId
# has been assigned/back-filled (so it is part of the key) and before save (so the not-yet-saved
# owner is not compared against itself).
checkIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdMemberCount

# Count the owners in this owner's household (sharing 'householdId'), including this
# not-yet-saved owner. Runs after the shared householdId has been assigned and back-filled.
assignHouseholdMemberCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdMemberCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Record how many existing owners share this owner's firstName and lastName
# (case-insensitively), before it is saved so the count excludes it.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code before saving: REGION from the postcode and
# HASH8 = SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)[0:8] upper hex. A stable per-owner identity,
# so this no longer depends on the count of existing owners.
assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

# Set 'bulkSignupWarning' true when more than 80 owners were already created today (by the
# adjusted business-day registrationDate), before saving so the count excludes this owner.
assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft-match: when the new owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but shares an existing
# owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone, still create it and set
# 'possibleDuplicate' true with 'possibleDuplicateOf' the matching owner id; otherwise false.
# Runs after the identity check (so hard duplicates never reach here) and before save.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line carrying the owner id, customerCode and registrationDate,
# after save so the generated id is available.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
=== GET ===
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

load:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied they take precedence. On output this is the
            composed address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when
            present. Normalized like 'address' (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand
            ST/RD/AVE) and stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or level).
            Normalized like addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth (ISO 8601). When present the owner's ageBand is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same
            last name at the same address (they share a household). Write-only; never stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the region code derived from the postcode, a hyphen, and the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3C70EBD8'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year."
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by all owners of one household (same last name at the same
                address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true; otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (the email and householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners with an equal
                identityKey are the same identity; creating a second owner with an existing key is
                rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when this owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds
                365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for
                2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                'true' when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by the adjusted
                business-day registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but, at the moment it
                was created, shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false

        title:

        status:

          format: int32

          maximum: 600

          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string

          readOnly: true

      required:
        - type

        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object

        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true

    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is
            combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied they take precedence. On output this is the
            composed address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when
            present. Normalized like 'address' (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand
            ST/RD/AVE) and stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or level).
            Normalized like addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth (ISO 8601). When present the owner's ageBand is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same
            last name at the same address (they share a household). Write-only; never stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the region code derived from the postcode, a hyphen, and the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3C70EBD8'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year."
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by all owners of one household (same last name at the same
                address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true; otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (the email and householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners with an equal
                identityKey are the same identity; creating a second owner with an existing key is
                rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when this owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0);
                add 2 for a household of 3 or more members; add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds
                365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for
                2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                'true' when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by the adjusted
                business-day registrationDate) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                'true' when this owner is not a hard (identityKey) duplicate but, at the moment it
                was created, shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged a possible duplicate of (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone). Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region code of the owner's identity: the REGION prefix of the
                customerCode (postcode range first - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099 - then the fixed city table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate against the registrationDate:

                when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is
            combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility;
            when structured address fields are supplied they take precedence. On output this is the
            composed address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when
            present. Normalized like 'address' (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand
            ST/RD/AVE) and stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or level).
            Normalized like addressLine1 and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth (ISO 8601). When present the owner's ageBand is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same
            last name at the same address (they share a household). Write-only; never stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the region code derived from the postcode, a hyphen, and the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3C70EBD8'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "Assigned identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year."
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by all owners of one household (same last name at the same
                address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true; otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (the email and householdId segments are empty when absent). Two owners with an equal
                identityKey are the same identity; creating a second owner with an existing key is
                rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C7B10D4'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
